Docs.summary: Provides types to discover device lights and request light states and effects.

remarks.para: Use to find lights and open a session. Build a from light states or a light effect, then submit it with .

Color and brightness control depend on the light hardware and are applied on a best-effort basis. Check a light's capabilities before using effects. A light type or capability constant does not establish that a device supports it.

Call when the session is no longer needed. Closing removes that session's requests; the manager can then honor requests from other sessions. It does not promise to restore a previously observed color.
See the Android 17 lights API source.
